integrity: The new statement is derived symbolically from the published uniform asymptotic formula. The bundled computation checks only the algebraic deductions, not the literature theorem itself.
scientific_limitations: The probability is unlabelled, over isomorphism classes of n-atom integral relation algebras.
No explicit convergence rate is claimed for the source asymptotic or for the overall nonsymmetry probability.
The conditional O(n^2 2^{-n}) concentration concerns the distribution inside the nonsymmetric tail, not representability.
No priority claim is made; the deduction may be folklore or implicit in older work.
title: A one-converse-pair law for rare nonsymmetry in finite relation algebras
